text:
tariq_pr: Heads up  a well-known podcast just said our Dedicated SLA is 99.99% in a recent episode. Our actual committed SLA is 99.9% for latency SLOs and 99.99% for uptime only on enterprise contracts. Need a quick clarification and to prep a short line for sales.

jen_engineering: Saw it. The pod edited the quote to sound like blanket 99.99% across all tiers. We should correct, but keep it low-friction. Recommend framing: 'Committed uptime SLA (enterprise) 99.99%; standard Dedicated latency SLA 99.9%.'

omar_marketing: Agreed. We'll ask the host for a short correction note they can read on the next episode and also post an official correction on our blog. Any legal concerns?

olivia_ops: No customer data involved. Ops confirms SLA language in the legal contract templates. If we share contract excerpts with the producer, we'll use redacted versions.

lucy_sales: I already had two inbound demo requests quoting 99.99%. Need a 1-paragraph note to forward to prospects with the precise language so reps don't overpromise.

tariq_pr: Draft to producer: "Hi Alex  quick correction: in your episode you mentioned Redwood Dedicated's SLA as 99.99% generally. For clarity: Redwood offers a 99.99% uptime SLA for enterprise Dedicated agreements; our standard Dedicated latency SLA is 99.9%. Happy to provide a one-line you can read on the feed and a short blog post link. Best, Tariq (PR)."

press_bot: reporter_email_delivered: true

producer_response: "Thanks Tariq  we'll add a short clarification read at the top of the next episode and update the episode notes. Please paste the one-line you'd like us to use."

jen_engineering: One-line for reading: "Correction: Redwood Dedicated's uptime SLA of 99.99% applies to enterprise contracts; standard Dedicated latency SLA is 99.9%."

olivia_ops: I'll prepare a redacted contract excerpt and upload to secure share in case the producer requests supporting docs. No customer IDs included.

ommararketing_typo_fix: (internal) -- ignore --

omar_marketing: Preparing blog correction post: short headline "Clarification on Redwood Dedicated SLA" and one-paragraph explaining tiers. Sales blurb ready too. Will post after producer confirms.

lucy_sales: Send the 1-paragraph to #sales and I'll forward to prospects who quoted 99.99%. That'll prevent confusion on calls.

press_bot: podcast_update_scheduled: next_episode_update_requested

tariq_pr: Producer confirmed they will run the read at the top and update show notes with our one-liner and a link to the blog clarification. Great.

omar_marketing: Blog correction live: https://redwood.example/blog/sla-clarification. Posted short FAQ: what SLA applies to which contract. Also added a pinned snippet in the Dedicated docs.

lucy_sales: Got it  posted the paragraph to #sales and updated the deck slide to show both numbers clearly. Forwarded to the two inbound leads.

jen_engineering: Logged a small item in the runbook: check outbound interviews for SLA phrasing before publish. Saves these frantic fixes.

press_bot: podcast_episode_note_updated: https://podcast.example/episode-123#notes

tariq_pr: Producer posted the read and updated notes. Link above. Closing loop  saved the email thread and assets into comms drive. If you see any more misquotes, ping me and we'll follow up. :white_check_mark:
